description: This deposit includes the English, Russian, and German master monographs, the bounded Journal Core article, source files, release assets, and audit materials for Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0. These materials support rebuilding, verifying, translating, and citing the release.
notes: The Journal Core article is a bounded extraction from the master monograph. Russian and German monographs are included as release translations of the same Core 1.3 package.
title: Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0
